title: Design System: มหานที (Mahanathi)

ground.purpose: The map-room dark; page background and WebGL clear colour. Never #000, never ultra-low-contrast grey.

sea.purpose: Slightly bluer than the ground; the sea early-out in the terrain shader.

panel.purpose: Solid panel equivalent: buttons, error card, station label, dev chrome.

panel-veil.purpose: The answer panel and station sheet over the relief, with the one functional blur(14px).

border.purpose: 1px separations that do the work shadows would do elsewhere.

border-strong.purpose: Primary-action border, active chip border, the draped Thai border line, the scrollbar thumb.

text-primary.purpose: Primary reading colour; 12.3:1 on the veil over the brightest terrain.

text-faint.purpose: Measured times, source credits, hollow stale dots in the legend; still AA on every surface.

accent-water.purpose: Rivers, links, focus ring, caret, range accent. The instrument's water colour - never neon.

sediment.purpose: Chao Phraya floodwater ochre: text selection background, relief tint family.

selection-bg.purpose: Text selection; the sediment ochre doing browser-surface duty.

scrollbar.purpose: Thin scrollbar on our slate, never the macOS default.

gauge-steel.purpose: The gauge pole and the bank-full cap; the stale hollow stroke is steel at 0.75.

gauge-track.purpose: The quiet slot above the water, below the cap.

relief-albedo-low.purpose: Muted paddy green over warm silt; the central plain. Consumed by the 3D scene, not CSS.

relief-albedo-high.purpose: Plaster and rock, lighter; the hypsometric tint's high end.

relief-neighbour.purpose: Neighbours desaturated and cooled via the provinces mask; Thailand keeps its colour.

relief-fog.purpose: The fog colour - the sea and the haze share the air. smoothstep(900, 2600) km, 85% at most.

situation-1.purpose: Drought arm of the scale; a different family from flood, carried by the blue axis that survives CVD simulation.

situation-2.purpose: Near-grey so the quiet third of the scale stays quiet; separates from 4-5 by colorfulness under CVD.

situation-5.purpose: The alert colour: level 5 and the gauge fill above the bank-full cap.

situation-stale.purpose: A graphic stroke colour (3:1 on ground), never a fill and never a text colour.

display.purpose: The scale's ceiling; caps at 4rem against the brief's 6rem maximum.

sentence.purpose: Noto Serif Thai 400, the typographic centrepiece of the answer panel; text-wrap balance, leading 1.65 for stacked Thai marks.

title.purpose: Section heads on the evidence pages.

title-sm.purpose: Station names; the station sentence at small size.

body.purpose: Default reading; leading 1.6 because Plex's worst measured ink box uses 84% of it (ADR 0005).

caption.purpose: Measured times, source credits, meta lines, chips.

wordmark.purpose: มหานที in the serif; no icon logo.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Reserved for Phase 4's elevated surfaces (menus, the expanded legend). Unused at the Phase 3 gate: the /lookdev panel separates by veil and border. No halos, no zero-blur blocks.

motion.name: camera
motion.purpose: Camera flights: preset moves and the one ใกล้ฉัน flight, interruptible by any user input.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out everywhere; the rig's easeOutExpo is its 3D mirror. Reduced motion cuts instead of flying.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: The only breakpoint: below it the station sheet is a bottom sheet and the answer panel goes full-width; at or above it the sheet becomes a 22rem bottom-right card.

narrative.overview:
Picture the national survey's plaster relief model of Thailand in a dark map room, lit only where water is being measured right now. Everything visible is either geography, data, or the words that explain the data. The relief is the page: there is no landing page, no hero section, no feature cards, no footer - the first frame is the product. Chrome is nearly absent: a wordmark, one primary action, and quiet panels that float over the terrain.

Restraint is the luxury. The palette comes from the subject - night slate (never #000), the ochre of Chao Phraya floodwater, muted paddy green, one disciplined alert family - and every colour lives in one TypeScript module that generates the CSS custom properties and is imported directly by the shaders. The 3D pipeline is deliberately flat so a token colour that survives lighting reaches the screen exactly. Type is Thai-first: Mahanathi Sans (IBM Plex Sans Thai, OFL-renamed) for the UI and numbers, Noto Serif Thai for the human sentence. Motion is exponential ease-out with one 1600 ms interruptible camera flight as the single authored moment; prefers-reduced-motion cuts instead of flying.

This system was proved on the dev surfaces /lookdev, /specimen and /color (Phase 3), gated item-by-item against the anti-slop checklist in docs/brief/01-DESIGN-DIRECTION.md §10 with screenshot evidence in docs/design/screens/phase-3/ and the scored pass in docs/design/GATE-phase-3.md. Phase 4 extends this world; it must not average it away.
keyCharacteristics: Dark theme only; night slate ground (#0e161d), never pure black, never ultra-low-contrast greys.
The relief is the page; UI floats over it as veils with 1px borders, not cards with shadows.
Two disciplined accents: muted water teal and ochre sediment. Strong colour belongs to data levels 4-5 only.
The situation scale is ordered, CVD-searched (Machado deuteranopia/protanopia, pairwise ΔE >= ~15), and geometrically redundant.
Thai-first typography with generous leading, tabular lining figures on every number, no italic anywhere.
One functional backdrop-filter blur(14px) pair (answer panel, station sheet); zero box-shadow declarations in shipped route CSS.
Camera moves only on input, presets, or the one flight; the renderer idles (frameloop="demand").

rules.name: The Single Source Rule
rules.body: Every colour lives in web/src/design/tokens.ts. tokens.css is generated from it (pnpm tokens:css) and a test fails on drift; shaders import the module. A hard-coded colour in a component, stylesheet or shader does not ship.

rules.name: The Flat Pipeline Rule
rules.body: The Canvas runs NoToneMapping (flat) with an opaque framebuffer, and both custom fragments close with three's tonemapping_fragment / colorspace_fragment chunks, so token colours round-trip to the screen exactly. Any new material must include the output chunks or it renders dark.

rules.name: The Quiet Third Rule
rules.body: Only levels 4 and 5 get strong colour. Levels 1-3 stay muted - the scale's CVD separation is carried by lightness, colorfulness and the blue axis, not by making everything loud.

rules.name: The Hollow Stale Rule
rules.body: Stale is a stroke, never a fill, everywhere: the 3D gauge is a hollow cap stroke, the legend dot is a hollow ring. Stale must never read as a level.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every measurement, count and timestamp is set with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums - signed columns must align.

rules.name: The Thai Stays in the DOM Rule
rules.body: Thai text never enters WebGL; labels over the relief are DOM elements projected from 3D positions, so stacked tone marks and vowels are shaped by the browser.

rules.name: The One Blur Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter: blur(14px) exists on exactly two surfaces - the answer panel and the station sheet - both for legibility over terrain. Glass is never decoration.

dos: Do take every colour from tokens.ts (or its generated CSS variables) - including shaders, which import the module.
Do include tonemapping_fragment / colorspace_fragment in any new custom fragment, and keep the Canvas flat.
Do put measured time and source on every data surface, in caption text-faint, with tabular lining figures.
Do keep the answer sentence in Noto Serif Thai with text-wrap: balance and 1.65 leading.
Do keep gauge encoding geometric first (cap at 0.78, fill inside, overflow above the cap, hollow stale) so colour is redundant, never load-bearing.
Do use 160-260ms exponential ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for UI state, 1.2-2.0s for camera flights, and cut instead of flying under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do theme browser surfaces (selection, focus ring, caret, scrollbar, underline offset, color-scheme: dark) - they are part of the design.
Do keep every surface that floats over the relief on the veil + 1px border recipe, and verify its text contrast over the brightest terrain.
donts: Don't add a hero section, card grids, section numbers, nested cards, a navbar of links or a marketing footer - the relief is the page.
Don't use purple, indigo or violet gradients, neon cyan on dark, gradient text, glowing borders, radial glow halos or spotlights, or cream/beige "un-slop" defaults.
Don't use glassmorphism beyond the two functional blurs, box-shadow in shipped chrome (the one reserved shadow is Phase 4's), or extreme border radii.
Don't use Inter, Geist, Roboto, Arial or the system UI font as the voice, or italic in any face, or crushed tracking (zero letter-spacing declarations exist).
Don't auto-rotate, wobble, starfield, particle, arc or bloom the 3D scene; the camera moves only on input, presets, or the one flight.
Don't put Thai text into WebGL, or let an unbounded orbit lose the horizon.
Don't give stale data a fill, or levels 1-3 strong colour, or the scale a sixth stop without re-running the CVD search.
Don't say ปลอดภัย, จะท่วม, ไม่ท่วม or anything that predicts or reassures; never claim safety. (Test-enforced.)
